Overview

Angers is a city in Pays de la Loire with a population of 153,000. A charming city on the Maine River, known for its medieval castle, lush gardens, and relaxed pace of life. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
